scope: ONE read-only source review of the new fresh-source software flow; no native admission
candidate: uncommitted source before bounded executor fixes; no source pin set recorded by reviewer

findings.finding: Valid symlink pins fail receipt verification: known() resolves the consumed path before comparing file_pin(path) against the original lexical pin. file_pin includes both path and resolved; valid compiler/library aliases can therefore compare unequal. Compare using the original pinned path or normalize both consistently.

Command dispatch can occur after the shared deadline: request/input revalidation follows the deadline check, and an expired remainder is converted to a positive 0.001-second timeout. Recheck after verification and refuse dispatch without remaining budget.
Inventory limits apply after unbounded traversal: sorted(build.rglob('*')) consumes the whole tree before deadline/512-entry checks. Enforce bounds while traversing before sorting/materialization.

reviewer_limitations: Read-only review; no tests, builds, native commands or resource queries. CMake compilation, native behavior and ABI remain untested; no admission or qualification established.
